static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.social_status: 有朋友与家人可倾诉，但尚not yet向他们分享具体担忧
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往without心理治疗/辅导史；过去not yet出现类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度Good、语气中性；能描述具体情境与自动化思维；在新任务与被伴侣观察时表现出Anxiety与犹豫

basic_info.main_problem: 我坚定地认为自己永远not会在更好的地方工作，因为我把自己看作一个skill有限的人。这种想法导致我在当前工作中感到能力not足和not满意。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到对自身skill与职业前景的信念正影响工作满意度与整体福祉，希望改变这些负性信念。
growth_experiences: 约一年前not yet获得晋升，随后持续出现“I am not good enough、能力有限”的自我评价与not足感；在上司成为伴侣后，这种not足感加剧，觉得既可能受到特殊对待又必须更努力证明自己，从而进一步怀疑自身能力。
工作中曾多次成功成交或有效帮助客户并获得客户的感谢与认可；但在回顾成绩时常感到这些成功“少而not稳”，难以维持自信，遇到新挑战便被负性思维覆盖。

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough / not competent enough
I am an 'impostor', I will be seen through at any time

special_situations.event: 一年前的晋升not yet获通过
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not被晋升，就说明I am not good enough、not值得更好的职位
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍提升skill、向伴侣（上司）寻求安慰与认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，我永远not会在更好的地方工作

special_situations.event: 处理新的房产交易任务时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对新任务not能迅速掌握，就说明我not胜任，会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免求助以免显得软弱；反复自我检查、犹豫not决
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会搞砸，do not人比我更能胜任

special_situations.event: The partner (boss) observes from the side or pays attention to my work performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在他面前表现not完美，他就会看穿我not称职并看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries harder to prove oneself, seeking their affirmation and reassurance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他会发现我not够能力/会看not起我

special_situations.event: 回顾工作表现时更关注失误与not足而忽略成功
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续、频繁的成功才算真正有能力，零散成功not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on errors and negative cues, downplays positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些成功只是运气，not代表我有能力

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent and reliable, and to obtain better career opportunities and a stable, supportive intimate relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被看穿not称职，遭受贬低/拒绝，地位与关系受损
defense_goal: 避免暴露not称职以获得安全感
通过Self-monitoring与回避来减少失败风险

object_relations.self_representation: not够胜任、容易被揭穿的“冒充者”
object_relations.object_representation: Supervisors / partners who scrutinize and judge, who may see through and belittle her at any time

object_relations.self_representation: 次等、需要证明自己的从属者
object_relations.object_representation: 更为优越的他人/同事（“do not人总能做得更好”）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the partner (boss) is present observing or evaluating work performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身的羞耻与not称职感Projection为对方的负面评价与审视（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tense tone, over-explains and proves oneself, avoids asking for help so as not to appear weak.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请以替代视角看待“能力与完美”的关系时（例如：not必完美也可胜任）
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向以理性分析方式讨论问题，淡化或隔离not适情绪以维持掌控感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use理性、分析性的语句回应，降低情感强度，避免深入情绪体验。

manifestations: 认为自己永远without法在更好的地方工作
以“能力有限”的标签看待自我
工作Decreased motivation、难以维持自信

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 认为“not能显得软弱”，因此避免求助
觉得必须not断证明自己更有能力

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在伴侣（上司）观察时加剧Self-doubt，反复自我检查与犹豫
Overly cautious when facing new tasks; second-guesses decisions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on.
manifestations: 担心伴侣/同事会看not起自己或看穿not称职
把内心的羞耻与not安理解为他人的负面评价

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对新的工作挑战或被伴侣（上司）观察时，来访者通常会Self-doubt、预测失败并避免求助，导致表现与Decreased confidence。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在以往的某些房产交易中，来访者成功完成成交、客户给予明确的感谢与认可；当时体验到一定的自信与能力感，与平时的新任务情境下的Self-doubtnot同。
exception_events.reason: 线索：获得客户的积极反馈与认可；任务更贴合既有经验与skill；在当次情境中更能关注具体可控步骤，从而降低了Self-doubt。

positive_force: 曾有成功成交与客户认可的经验
愿意尝试提升skill与进行认知重构
能觉察负性思维并主动求助咨询
Has some social support resources (friends and family)
negative_force: Predicting failure (Fortune Telling) and mind reading of others' evaluations (Mind Reading)
心理过滤与贬低正向证据（Mental Filtering/negate正面）
避免求助以免显得软弱，过度Self-monitoring
Dependence on external recognition (seeking a partner's / supervisor's reassurance and affirmation)

target_behavior.behavior: 工作情境下的过度Self-doubt与回避求助（伴随Significant anxiety与二次猜测）
antecedent: 伴侣（上司）在场观察或评价
回忆not yet获晋升与相关评价情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次not yet获晋升过度概括为自身without能，强烈依赖外部评价并害怕失败被看穿，从而形成灾难化预测与心读他人负面看法。
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与暴露not称职的风险，维持表面形象与关系安全感。
target_behavior.consequence: 工作满意度与表现下降，动机与Impaired self-esteem，Career development受限。
